event_name: Date 31 August 2018 Time 11:42 2018 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 30 August - 02 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 7), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbo Charger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H), 4th Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 4th Energy Store and 4th Control Electronics have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b).
